page.overview:
What is Angelhead Mine?

Angelhead Mine was a mine found in the Sword Coast North in the late 15 century DR. It was likely named for the enormous statue of an angelic being found within its depths.

The mine lay beneath the hills just inland from Raven Cliff Beach, a short distance away from Cragmire Keep and Cragmire Barrow and just off the High Road north of Neverwinter.

The mine had several entrances standing amongst the hills. These were supported with high arches built into sturdy stone walls, with wooden pillars and a shelter out the front. Each arch was secured with a portcullis to bar entry.

Found lying amongst the rocks outside the main mine entrance was a runestone inscribed with runes of an unknown script and language. A translation read "with a heavy pick slung over his shoulder the bearded miner heads deep into the earth in search of precious metals and gemstones the quintessential dwarf".
